name: Tamura Kouhei
source:
Birthplace: Tokyo
Lives with his parents and older sister.
His parents own a little grocery store, he doesn't get along with his stubborn father.
He looks nice, but he's still a childish middle schooler who loves toys and super hero TV shows.
A pure kid who is simple but hard working.
